name: Weatherlight
description: The Weatherlight is a legendary skyship, designed by Urza and famed as the airship captained by Sisay and crewed by Gerrard and his friends.

summary.text: The Weatherlight is a legendary skyship, designed by Urza and famed as the airship captained by Sisay and crewed by Gerrard and his friends.

bio.text: Urza built the ship and collapsed Serra's Realm into its powerstone core, giving it the power to travel the planes, and on its maiden voyage Jhoira as captain rescued thousands of refugees.

citations.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Urza", section "Building the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Worldsoul", section "Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Weatherlight Saga, Sisay's crew, joined by Gerrard, Mirri and Rofellos, searched the planes for the pieces of the Legacy, and Volrath had Sisay abducted to lure the ship to Rath, where the Predator ambushed it and took hostages.

citations.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the crew rescued Sisay and escaped Rath, the ship crash-landed in Mercadia, where the Cho-Arrim stole it, and it was reclaimed from the Subterranean Hangar and returned to Dominaria.

citations.text: "Mercadia", section "The Mercadian Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian Invasion the Weatherlight was destroyed by the Primevals at Urborg and reborn by Karn with the Thran Tome as a sentient being, and it absorbed the Null Moon's white mana to strike at Yawgmoth.

citations.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dominaria (plane)", section "First Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Null Moon", section "Null Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: When Gerrard, Urza and Karn completed the Legacy and defeated Yawgmoth, the Weatherlight sank off Urborg.

citations.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sixty years after the Mending, Jhoira raised the wreck, restored it with a new hull seed and assembled a new crew against Belzenlok's Cabal, and the rebuilt ship served as the group's base.

citations.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "Reconstruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the war against the Phyrexians it was covered in Phyrexian garbage as camouflage but became corrupted and flew away, and was later seen compleated and used against the Mana Rig.

citations.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

citations.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza saves refugees and collapses the plane into the Weatherlight's powerstone.
timeline.quote: saved many Serran refugees before collapsing the plane

citation.text: "Serra", section "Radiant and the end of the Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza returns with the Weatherlight, rescues thousands of refugees and collapses the plane into the ship's powerstone core.
timeline.quote: rescuing thousands of Serran refugees before finally collapsing the plane into the ship's powerstone core

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay recalls throwing fruit to drakes along the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds."

citation.text: Teferi's Drake (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay and the Weatherlight land before Asmira and Rashida's party.
timeline.quote: Sisay and her flying galleon, the Weatherlight , landed before them.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Shocking Visions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns to the Weatherlight as captain in Sisay's absence after serving in the Benalish army.
timeline.quote: Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence

citation.text: Gerrard (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri rejoins Gerrard aboard the Weatherlight as his unofficial first mate.
timeline.quote: she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate

citation.text: Mirri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax joins the Weatherlight crew to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.

citation.text: Crovax (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax accepts a place aboard the Weatherlight, leaving his rotting family.
timeline.quote: "You must be mad to want one such as I aboard the *Weatherlight*. But I would be mad to remain here with my rotting family. I accept."

citation.text: Shattered Crypt (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight banks as an aboroth rises to crush a lone rider.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider.

citation.text: Aboroth (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri join Sisay's Weatherlight crew after Gerrard loses a wager.
timeline.quote: with Gerrard having lost a tavern wager over a contest of knife-throwing against her

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard falls in love with navigator Hanna.
timeline.quote: Gerrard fell in love with the ship's navigator, Hanna

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna befriends Orim at university and the two join the crew of the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Hanna befriended Orim while at the university, and later the pair joined the crew of Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri joins the Weatherlight crew with Rofellos and Gerrard to find the Legacy artifacts.
timeline.quote: Mirri joined the crew of the Skyship Weatherlight in its quest to find the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Greven il-Vec takes the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard falls overboard.
timeline.quote: they were unable to stop Greven il -Vec from taking the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri sees Crovax sabotaging the Weatherlight's sails, attacks him, and both tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden.
timeline.quote: She attacked Crovax, causing both of them to tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden .

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
timeline.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator and Weatherlight duel as Weatherlight races to the portal Ertai holds open; Weatherlight escapes and both ships are heavily damaged.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator battles Weatherlight over Urborg; Ertai captures Gerrard and teleports him into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: managed to capture Gerrard and teleport him directly into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven and Predator is destroyed by being sent crashing into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay becomes a minor celebrity during the Mirage Wars, spying on enemy positions for the Zhalfirin armies.
timeline.quote: She became a minor celebrity during the Mirage Wars

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay meets Gerrard and others influenced by the bloodline project, who join the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Among them Gerrard , the true heir to the Legacy.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight's maiden voyage rescues thousands of refugees from collapsing Serra's Realm with Jhoira as captain.
timeline.quote: The skyship's maiden voyage was devoted to rescuing thousands of refugees from the collapsing Realm, with Jhoira serving as its first captain.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza entrusts the ship to a Zhalfirin family; Sisay inherits it after the family is killed by the Lord of the Wastes.
timeline.quote: Sisay inherited the ship from her family after they were mysteriously killed by the Lord of the Wastes .

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages.
timeline.quote: Predator' s crew took Karn , Tahngarth , and the Legacy artifacts hostage

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight and Predator duel again as Weatherlight races to the portal and escapes.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Mercadia the ship is upgraded and helps free the people from Phyrexian oppressors.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight was also instrumental in freeing the peoples of Mercadia from their Phyrexian oppressors.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ship is destroyed by the Primeval Crosis and reborn as a sentient being, then destroyed a final time over Urborg.
timeline.quote: The ship was destroyed by the Primeval Crosis , only to be reborn as a completely sentient being.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in the Talruum Mountains; Tahngarth fights as Sisay's champion, defeats Ghentoth and joins her crew.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth offered to fight as Sisay's champion and proved himself by defeating Ghentoth.

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew searches the planes for the pieces of the Legacy before the invasion commences.
timeline.quote: its intrepid crew searches the planes to find all of the pieces of the Legacy before the invasion commences

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Captain Sisay is kidnapped and the crew must travel to Rath to save her.
timeline.quote: captain Sisay has been kidnapped, and they have to travel to the plane of Rath to save her

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay says angering the gods turns clouds against you.
timeline.quote: "You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."

citation.text: Cloud Elemental (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Enfeeblement (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barbed slivers form a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Barbed Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator lists the Weatherlight and Hanna screams.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed.

citation.text: Sudden Impact (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax leaves Urborg to join the Weatherlight crew, taking the artifact binding Selenia.
timeline.quote: He took with him the artifact controlling Selenia so that he could be with her.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Oracle declares Gerrard the Korvecdal, convincing Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: The Oracle's proclamation convinced Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew in their rescue mission

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Ertai opens a portal with Lyna's help but is left behind as the Weatherlight flees Predator.
timeline.quote: the Weatherlight was being hotly pursued by Predator as it fled, and so was forced to leave Ertai behind.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard learns Starke betrayed the Phyrexians and had been feeding Sisay information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: it was none other than Starke who had betrayed his masters and had supplied Sisay with information about the Legacy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard reanimates the frozen Karn using his instinctive knowledge of artifice as heir to the Legacy.
timeline.quote: Gerrard managed to reanimate him with the instinctive knowledge of artifice he had as heir to the Legacy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath orders Greven to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
timeline.quote: the evincar Volrath entrusted Greven with a crucial mission

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator ambushes Weatherlight and overpowers its crew.
timeline.quote: Predator caught it by surprise, boarded it, and soon overpowered its crew.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight smashes Predator into the Stronghold, then escapes through the Erratic Portal and Predator crashes into the rock face.
timeline.quote: Unable to stop in time, Predator smashed into the rock face, sustaining heavy damage.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
timeline.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.
timeline.quote: where they freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight crashes on Mercadia, where Sisay gathers artifacts to repair the ship and leads the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.
timeline.quote: she led the oppressed peoples of the plane to a successful shift in regime

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out on stormy Rath to find Volrath's stronghold.
timeline.quote: where Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out to find Volrath 's stronghold

citation.text: "Tempest", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it, and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts; Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest.
timeline.quote: He organized the abduction of Sisay to lure Weatherlight to Rath

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew journey through Volrath's Stronghold, battling Volrath's creations to rescue imprisoned comrades.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and the crew of the Weatherlight journey through the bowels of Volrath 's Stronghold

citation.text: "Stronghold", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight hauls the Predator behind it.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* dragged the *Predator* behind it

citation.text: Cataclysm (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flowstone lunges at the Weatherlight, seeming to take on Greven's rage.
timeline.quote: it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Seismic Assault (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew, having rescued Sisay and pieces of the Legacy, must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath.
timeline.quote: The crew of the Weatherlight has rescued Captain Sisay and the pieces of the Legacy

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A change comes over Crovax, whose bloodlust threatens the ship.
timeline.quote: His newly-formed bloodlust and thirst for power threaten to destroy the entire ship.

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay recruits Gerrard and his friends as Weatherlight crew after a knife-throwing contest.
timeline.quote: recruited the companions as crew on the Weatherlight as payment for a bet

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Mirri leave the Weatherlight crew, blaming the Legacy for Rofellos's death.
timeline.quote: Gerrard, with Mirri in tow, left the crew of the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejoins the Weatherlight and appoints Tahngarth first mate.
timeline.quote: Gerrard is introduced to old and new crewmates and appoints Tahngarth as the first mate

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An aboroth chases the Weatherlight until elvish war machines stop it.
timeline.quote: The monster pursues the Weatherlight, almost catching its sails when it is stopped by elvish war machines.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator ambushes the Weatherlight under Greven's command.
timeline.quote: they were ambushed by the Predator , under the command of Greven il- Vec.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crashes in the Skyshroud forest.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight, meanwhile, crashed in the Shyshroud forest.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The moggs break the Thran crystal, stranding the crew on Rath.
timeline.quote: the moggs broke the Thran crystal during their attack, stranding them on Rath

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slivers burst into the Weatherlight in the Furnace of Rath.
timeline.quote: the slivers burst through the walls of the cave to attack the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna saves the ship from burning with an improvised lightning rod.
timeline.quote: Hanna made an improvised lightning rod from a piece of railing and saved the ship from burning.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna fires a beam from the steering wheel at the ornithopters.
timeline.quote: She then causes a beam of light to fire from the steering wheel

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax ambushes Mirri in the lower deck of the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Mirri is ambushed from behind somewhere in the lower deck by her former ally, who says it is his destiny for him to kill her.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight leaves Ertai behind on Rath.
timeline.quote: they were forced to leave Ertai behind on Rath

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza completes the skyship and christens it the Weatherlight, naming Karn Master of Engines and Jhoira Captain.
timeline.quote: Urza christens it the Weatherlight and names Karn the Master of Engines and Jhoira the Captain.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Serra's Realm Barrin tricks Gorig into impaling itself on the Weatherlight, charging the powerstone, while Radiant kills Gherridarigaaz and rips out Urza's powerstone eyes.
timeline.quote: Radiant challenges Urza to single combat and kills Gherridarigaaz.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza collapses Serra's Realm's worldsoul into the Weatherlight's powerstone core, giving it the power to travel the planes.
timeline.quote: giving it enough power to travel the planes

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Dominarians win thanks to the Weatherlight crew, but the Metathran race dies out with the war.
timeline.quote: the Metathran race died out with the war they were born to fight.

citation.text: "Metathran", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Rath, Greven il-Vec commandeers the Weatherlight and confiscates Legacy pieces for Volrath; Karn gets them from the Sliver Queen.
timeline.quote: the Queen let Karn take the Legacy from her.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza builds the Weatherlight and sacrifices the energies of Serra's Realm to power it.
timeline.quote: Urza decided to use the energies of the collapsing Phyrexian-overrun plane of Serra's Realm

citation.text: "Urza", section "Building the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Weatherlight completed, Urza begins a eugenics program to create a perfect crew and engineer soldiers against the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: With the Weatherlight completed, Urza now works on a eugenics program to create a perfect crew for it

citation.text: "Urza's Destiny", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight bursts from the underground hangar as Mercadia falls.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

citation.text: Mercadia's Downfall (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay run deeper into the mountain unwilling to leave without the Weatherlight and crew.
timeline.quote: Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

citation.text: Tremor (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay is restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sails for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria.

citation.text: Tranquility (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn repairs the planeswalking engine and sees how to catalyze the Weatherlight's evolution.
timeline.quote: Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

citation.text: Power Matrix (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia, the Cho-Arrim attack, and Hanna and others are arrested.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight crash-landed on Mercadia after departing Rath.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath's plot is revealed; during the Revolution on Mercadia the crew escapes aboard the empowered Weatherlight with Ramos's help.
